Class StringUtils

public inherited sharing class StringUtils

Utility class for handling string operations. Provides methods for character manipulation, email validation, string splitting, and default value handling. This class offers reusable string processing utilities for common Salesforce development scenarios.

Group:
    Utilities

Since:
    08/17/2024

Version:
    1.4


Change Log

  • 08/17/2024 - v1.0 - Initial version
  • 08/26/2024 - v1.1 - Added getBlankValue() method to get the default value if the input value is blank
  • 08/30/2024 - v1.2 - Added isValidEmail() and isNotValidEmail() methods to validate an email address
  • 07/12/2025 - v1.3 - Added split() method to split a string by comma, semicolon and line feeds, trimming whitespace
  • 11/01/2025 - v1.4 - Added isValidId() method to validate Salesforce Ids
